eventDetail.scope: ISCAIT 2027 provides an international forum for researchers and practitioners to present advances in artificial intelligence, intelligent systems, computational intelligence, and related information technologies. The conference welcomes contributions on both theoretical developments and practical applications across a wide range of domains. Topics of interest include machine learning, data analytics, intelligent systems, and human centered computing, with particular attention to methods that are scalable, robust, and trustworthy. The event encourages interdisciplinary research that bridges fundamental theory and real world deployment. ISCAIT 2027 aims to promote exchange of ideas and foster collaboration among academia, industry, and research communities worldwide.
